translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: kx yrle mz nibr nzycmne-plztitr-krbz Profet Neitzn mz nzmwimi-krde Batsibz.

content.text: Gct, nayc mz drtwrm ninge,
X atubqtim nzvz-rbr-krngeng, murde aodu-zvzq ninge.
Wztibz nabznge mz alwx rngeng amrlx
Kcng tzatrkatilr ninge.
Murde opxpe mz mzke' nzvz-rbr-krngeng.
X plzpxbo nzesablqti-zvz-krnge nim,
X myapxbz nim kc tqxpqbrlr-ngrne
Mz nzrnzlvzo-krnge Loukxtr scm.
Delc, tubqq mz nzrpi-krme bange kx vz-rbrx,
X mz nzyrlq-krm nzayrplapxngr ninge.
Mrlzm bange nzale-krnge alwx
Murde mzli kc tqmncbe-ngrne mz nelz lxenge, alwx rnge ycpebz.
A' suti drtwrm kx nabznge navz-nqblqle nzmncngr angidr.
Delc, na-alvztr-ngrn ninge murde nayrplapxx.
Wzti-angidrbz nabznge,
Murde nzprki-krnge namyaszpxle nqbya r nrc.
Ipq ninge murde na-abrtzx,
X drtwrnge kc tqavzbzme naelalz-mop.
Bzkq obqtrpeq nzmyakr drtqnge mz alwx rngeng,
A' ipqpxbz alwx rngeng amrlx.
Gct, tekqtrpz nabznge murde natubqx,
X amrnale mqngrnge murde navz-nqblqx nim.
Bzkq maszlrpx-ngrn ninge mz nzmnctr-krbo bam.
X bzkq katxpxq nzokatrkr Mqngrm ninge.
Okatrp ninge murde na-abrtz-mou-ngrne nzarlapx-krm ninge,
X drtqnge navq mz nzvz-nqblqngr natqm.
Zbz sa na-alvztrpo nqmq krmqng mz kxdrka'-ngrng,
Murde nayzlu-mopwzlr bam.
Gct, bzkq ayzlu-mope' bange nzrnibq-krnge ncblo,
Murde na-angrlvzx nim mz nzarlapx-krm lc ninge.
Kxetu, okatrp ninge
Murde naglqlz-ngrne nim nivz lrm.
Trabrtz-ngrwq nzangco-ngrm blz mz olta nyzm.
A' blz kx mrlzbz bam nabz leplz kx avzo-lzbq x plzpxle alwx ngrdeng.
Delc trna-angco-ngrpwc'u blz mz olta nyzm,
A' avzo-lzbq-zvztxpwo bam.
Krka'-ngrbo bam kx naokatrpe' nigr leplz nemqng
Mz nzamqngi-mou-krgr drkq ngr Jerusalem.
Murde nzangco-krmgr blz mz olta nyzmnavzpxm mz nzka-lzbq-krbzkr bam.
X krlc blz kxtubq mz nzobq-krm.
